race.description: Jr Richards & Sons Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: NUGGET SMART (7) has been about the mark all prep and should be peaking at the fourth run back. Stalked the leader then battled on well to hold third last start over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Needs 1400m now and with a bit of luck from the tricky gate he can take this out. SABATINA (4) stepped up sharply from 950m to 1400m at Forbes last time out and produced a big finish to get up for a close fourth at huge odds. Should get a strong tempo here and will be tough to hold out. THE CONFIDANTE (1) returned to form at Forbes recently, getting up in a nail-biter over today's journey. Both his wins have come at this trip - expect he can hold the good form. TAKE THE CHANCE (5) took a commanding lead into the straight but found a couple better in the run home last start over 1300m at Bathurst. Can run another cheeky race. Greybeard BROGANS CREEK (8) showed a glimpse of form at Muswellbrook last time. Placed three of six here so not out of the question.
